disclaimer: JWC listed-area polygons are our reading of Joint War Committee circular JWLA-035 (16 September 2026), drawn from the published coordinates and a public-domain coastline. They are illustrative only. The wording of the circular prevails. The Joint War Committee does not set premiums; ships sailing into a listed area would be required to notify underwriters, and rating is a matter for negotiation. Advisory (amber) areas are indicative naval and industry warning footprints, not official legal boundaries. Not insurance, routing or navigation advice.
coastline_source: Natural Earth 50m countries and ocean (public domain), used only to draw 12 nautical mile coastal belts and to clip land from the defined-water boxes.

properties.detail: Waters enclosed: Red Sea south of 25.5°N (Egyptian territorial waters excluded); from the Pakistan coastline at 25°19′15″N, 65°E; east by a line to 10°48′N, 65°E, then 10°48′N, 60°15′E, then 6°45′S, 48°45′E; southwest from the Somalia border at 1°40′S, 41°34′E to 6°45′S, 48°45′E. properties.name: Black Sea (except some territorial waters)
properties.meaning: JWC listed area. Ships entering must notify hull-war underwriters. Rating is a private negotiation; the Joint War Committee does not set premiums.
properties.detail: JWLA-035 lists the Black Sea excluding territorial waters of adjoining countries other than Russia and Ukraine. This drawing insets about 12 nautical miles off Romania, Bulgaria, Turkey and Georgia. Inland waters of Ukraine (including Crimea and other Ukrainian territories under Russian control), the River Don to 41°E, the River Donets to the Ukraine border, and Belarus south of 52°30′N are also listed in the circular but are not drawn in full here. The circular wording prevails.

properties.name: UKMTO Voluntary Reporting Area
properties.meaning: Naval / industry advisory area. This is not a JWC listed-area boundary. Cover and routing decisions remain with owners, masters and insurers.
properties.threat_as_of_note: JMIC Update 112, ICOD 08 Nov 2026 13:00 UTC (13:00 UK).
properties.detail: Indicative outline of the UKMTO Voluntary Reporting Area (Suez, the western entrance to the Strait of Hormuz, longitude 078°E and latitude 10°S, as commonly described; the authoritative picture is Admiralty Maritime Security Chart Q6099).
